description: This file defines the BusinessDateDTO class, a Data Transfer Object used to encapsulate information about business dates, including a description, type, date, and changes. It provides methods to add individual changes and bulk changes.

classes.name: BusinessDateDTO
classes.description: A serializable data transfer object for representing business dates with descriptions, types, and change mappings.

methods.name: addChange
methods.description: Adds or updates a specific change for a given BusinessDateType with the associated LocalDate.

methods.name: addAllChanges
methods.description: Adds multiple changes from a provided map, invoking addChange for each entry.
